Disclaimer

It has come to our notice that fake job offers are being offered on behalf of Eterno Infotech Private Limited ( "Eterno") by certain individuals/entities claiming they are representatives, subsidiaries or under contract with Eterno.

Eterno does not:

  1. Send job offers from free email services like Gmail, Rediffmail, Yahoo mail, Hotmail, etc.
  2. Request payment of any kind from prospective candidates for employment.
  3. Authorize anyone to collect money or arrive at any monetary arrangement in return for a job at Eterno.

However, in cases when the recruitment process is done through professional recruiting agencies, offers are always made directly by Eterno.

Please note that Eterno:

  1. Will not be responsible to anyone acting on an employment offer not directly made by Eterno.
  2. Has not authorised anyone to make an employment offer and any such offer extended is not for an approved job.
  3. Reserves the right to take legal action, including criminal action, against such individuals/entities

"If you receive any unauthorized, suspicious or fraudulent offers or interview call, Please write an email to us at hr@eternoinfo.com. All official emails from Eterno would have a domain @eternoinfo.com"

Our Story

Eterno was built on the precincts of a clear and unmet need of quality content for the vernacular populace in India.

The central idea was to serve and empower local languages. The challenge was not only to build a translation engine, rather deliver a true tech driven localisation platform; A platform that empathises with the cultural nuances and the real context that can only be discovered in one's mother tongue.

Explore Our Story

Currently operating the Dailyhunt brand in India, Eterno uses an external proprietary AI/ML tech stack that is empowered by deep learning technologies.

The platform enables the understanding of user preference and helps deliver real time personalised content.

Emerging as the largest local language content platform, this extensive content aggregation has enabled clients with advertising solutions that help them reach an audience that was not accessible before.

Leading the vernacular content aspirations of Bharat, Dailyhunt is India’s #1 content platform.

The Dailyhunt app is available across Android, iOS, windows, and the mobile web.

Philosophy

A kaleidoscope of languages, here each shade, every colour depicting India’s rich linguistic heritage is celebrated.

At its heart Eterno seeks to build and propagate a platform of empowerment. It seeks to reduce the dominance of one language at the cost of the other. This is done by providing the much needed technological platform that allows for the proliferation of content in local languages.

Our endeavour is to build an ecosystem that nurtures the diversity of languages and showcases its cultural values across the nation.

In fact, our endeavour is to preserve and proliferate the DNA of Bharat that is "unity in diversity".

Mission Statement of Eterno

Our mission is to be ‘the platform empowering a billion Indians to discover, consume and socialise with content that informs, enriches and entertains.’

Leading the vernacular content aspirations of Bharat, Dailyhunt is India’s #1 content platform.

It reflects the diversity of the nation with an equally astounding 115,000+ new content artifacts every day in 14 languages.

This is made possible by 50,000 plus content partners and an even broader ecosystem of individual creators.

Dailyhunt enthrals over 285 million active users across the nation with over 30 billion page views and 9 billion video views per month.

Eterno sources high end machine learning as well as deep learning technologies to bring an intelligent and intuitive rhythm to this vast canvas.

Visit Dailyhunt

Your world
in your language

At Eterno, we know the 'mother' in the mother tongue exists for a reason.

We believe that while words may transmit information, it is one's mothers tongue that conveys meaning.

Just like your mother, your mother tongue not only helps you understand the world around you but also makes you feel understood.

Therefore we strive to give our audience content in a language that is their own.

So that not only can they watch and read but also feel.
